execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."code_languages" (
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."courses" (
  "description" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."groups" (
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "id_course" int4 NOT NULL,
  "position" int4 NOT NULL,
  "state" text DEFAULT 'open' NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "groups_positive_position_a1898ac2" CHECK (position >= 1),
  CONSTRAINT "groups_state_check_979be375" CHECK ("state" IN ('open', 'locked', 'hidden'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."lesson_progress" (
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "id_lesson" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id_student" uuid NOT NULL,
  "practice_completed_at" timestamptz,
  "test_completed_at" timestamptz,
  "theory_completed_at" timestamptz,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."lessons" (
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "id_group" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id_practice" int4,
  "id_test" int4,
  "id_theory" int4,
  "is_hidden" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "position" int4 NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "lessons_materials_required_ac5b09aa" CHECK (num_nonnulls(id_theory, id_practice, id_test) >= 1),
  CONSTRAINT "lessons_positive_position_a1898ac2" CHECK (position >= 1)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."practice_files" (
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "filename" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "id_code_language" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id_practice" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."practice_saves" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "id_practice" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id_student" uuid NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."practices" (
  "description" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "mdx_source" text NOT NULL,
  "test_js" text NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."question_options" (
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "id_question" int4 NOT NULL,
  "is_correct" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "position" int4 NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "options_positive_position_a1898ac2" CHECK (position >= 1)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."save_files" (
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "id_practice_file" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id_practice_save" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."student_sessions" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expires_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "id_student" uuid NOT NULL,
  "token_hash" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "sessions_valid_expiry_5a5e9d22" CHECK (expires_at > created_at)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."students" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "display_code" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "label" text,
  "recovery_code" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."technologies" (
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."test_questions" (
  "code_block" text,
  "description" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "id_code_language" int4,
  "id_test" int4 NOT NULL,
  "position" int4 NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text DEFAULT 'single' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "questions_positive_position_a1898ac2" CHECK (position >= 1),
  CONSTRAINT "test_questions_type_check_811a06af" CHECK ("type" IN ('single', 'multiple'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."tests" (
  "description" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."theories" (
  "description" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "id_technology" int4 NOT NULL,
  "mdx_source" text NOT NULL,
  "position" int4 NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "theories_positive_position_a1898ac2" CHECK (position >= 1)
)
